user.title: Set up Roomba Custom
user.description: How would you like to connect to your Roomba?

cloud.title: Sign in to your iRobot account
cloud.description: Enter the same email and password you use in the iRobot app. Your Roomba will be found automatically — no IP address or BLID needed.

pick.title: Choose your Roomba
pick.description: Found {count} robot(s) on your account. Select the one you want to add.

manual.title: Enter credentials manually
manual.description:
Enter your Roomba's local credentials.

To retrieve your BLID and password, see the [documentation]({help_url}).

error.invalid_auth: Incorrect iRobot email or password. Please check and try again.
error.cloud_error: Could not connect to the iRobot cloud. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the Roomba. Check the IP address and credentials, and make sure no other app (iRobot app, another integration) is connected at the same time.
